title: Natural Gas Glossary
description: Natural gas is used extensively in residential, commercial and industrial applications. A natural gas glossary with search terms from the American Gas Association.

rows: Natural gas that has been cooled to -162°C to become a liquid for storage and transportation
A unit of energy equal to the amount of heat required to raise the temperature of one pound of water by one degree Fahrenheit
A unit of volume measurement for natural gas in metric systems
The process of removing natural gas from underground reservoirs
Infrastructure used to transport natural gas from production sites to distribution centers and consumers
A device that controls the pressure and flow rate of natural gas in pipelines and appliances
Equipment used to increase the pressure of natural gas for transmission through pipelines
The amount of energy released when a unit volume of natural gas is completely combusted
Natural gas that contains minimal amounts of hydrocarbons and water vapor
Natural gas that contains significant amounts of hydrocarbon liquids and water vapor
components.content: This glossary contains common terms and definitions used in the natural gas industry. For comprehensive definitions, visit the [American Gas Association Glossary](https://www.aga.org/natural-gas-glossary).
